description: Search active marketplace listings on EX & GO (exgo.io), the classifieds marketplace for Ukraine and Europe (24 per page). All filters optional. Results marked `promoted: true` are paid top placements — up to 12 of them come first on page 1, the rest keep their organic position; say they are paid when reporting them, do not present a paid placement as the best match. Under the default `new` sort a paid BUMP also moves a listing up. When few or no listings matched as asked, the answer carries a `related` array of the nearest listings — those did not match the query, so report them as "nothing exactly like that, here is what is close", never as stock. Every listing has a `url` on the site; show it.

attributeRanges.description: numeric attribute ranges, e.g. {"year":{"min":2015}}; needs `category`, number attributes only

attributes.description: category attribute filters, e.g. {"brand":"skoda"}; needs `category`, keys from list_categories

city.description: city slug, e.g. 'kyiv' — or several comma-separated ('kyiv,lviv') to match any of them

maxPrice.description: highest price, inclusive, in UAH (other currencies converted), or in `priceCurrency`

minPrice.description: lowest price, inclusive, in UAH (other currencies converted), or in `priceCurrency`

priceCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency of minPrice/maxPrice (default UAH) — converted at the bank's rate like the catalogue's own filter

radiusKm.description: radius in km around `city`: also matches listings pinned within it (needs `city`)

sort.description: 'new' (default) orders by freshness, which a paid BUMP resets, then relevance; 'cheap'/'expensive' order by price

name: search_listings
